📖 How to use

  1. Paste your text (a poem, lyrics or a paragraph).
  2. Read total syllables, word count and average syllables per word instantly.
  3. Check the per-word table to see the syllable count of each word.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How are syllables counted?

A standard heuristic: each group of vowels (a, e, i, o, u, y) counts as one syllable, a silent trailing "e" is dropped, and every word gets at least one syllable.

Is it 100% accurate?

No heuristic is perfect for English — it is about 95%+ accurate on normal prose. Check the per-word table for any word you doubt.

Can I use it for haiku?

Yes. The total-syllable readout makes it easy to check the 5-7-5 pattern line by line.
